text:
### Joint Account Support  
SmartSaver supports joint accounts with up to 2 account holders.  
**Joint Account Features:**
- Both signatories on account opening
- Either signatory can withdraw full balance
- Interest calculated on total balance
- Regulatory treatment: Both holders jointly and severally liable
- Dispute resolution per Complaints Policy (COM-POL-006)  
**See:** [[business_ontology]] — Joint Account concept

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Arrangement
raw_entities.description: A joint account arrangement where both account holders are jointly and severally liable for the account. This regulatory treatment means each holder is individually responsible for the full account balance and obligations.
context: Regulatory treatment: Both holders jointly and severally liable

Defined in the FirstUK Bank business ontology with specific rules governing signatory authority, withdrawal rights, and regulatory treatment.
context: SmartSaver supports joint accounts with up to 2 account holders

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Signatory Authority
raw_entities.description: A business rule governing signatory authority on joint accounts, establishing that either signatory can withdraw the full balance without requiring consent from the other account holder.
context: Either signatory can withdraw full balance

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Interest Calculation Rule
raw_entities.description: A business rule specifying that interest on joint accounts is calculated on the total balance held across all signatories, rather than on individual portions.

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Dispute Resolution Authority
raw_entities.description: A business rule establishing that disputes on joint accounts are resolved in accordance with the Complaints Policy (COM-POL-006), ensuring consistent handling of customer complaints.

raw_entities.name: Complaints Policy Authority
raw_entities.description: The governance framework and policy document (COM-POL-006) that establishes the procedures and authority for resolving customer complaints on joint accounts and other banking products.

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Signatory
raw_entities.description: A person with legal rights and obligations as a signatory on a joint account. Both signatories have equal authority to withdraw funds and are jointly and severally liable for the account.
